title: The merge tool posts a review record after each review round
note: Named by lane review-rounds-rework in PR #1552 (coordinator, 16:33 CST Nov 7). Done check: each round leaves a merge-tool record on the PR. Sighting (lane stall-watch-quiet-lint, PR #1823, 01:47 CST Nov 8): no review record after rounds 1 and 2, so `merge --review-record --fix-check` could not attach a fix check, and a full round 3 ran in its place. Sighting (lane agent-report-shas-resolve, session_013NEJL1333yS5ziKFeWsjHC, PR #1864, 03:29 CST Nov 8): the lane opened its draft PR only after review round 2, so the merge tool had no PR to hold a record for round 2's head (decision pr-review-record wants one per reviewed head), and round 3 ran in place of a fix check. Folded in: the lane's suggested step lane-pr-before-review (a lane opens its draft PR before review round 1, by a guard on reviewer spawns or a line in the lane brief template); a record after each round needs that PR to exist. Sighting (timing-tests lane, 07:22 CST Nov 8): no record was posted after the round-1 and round-2 FAILs on #1147, so the fix-check route was refused; the lane asks for a reminder in the review flow after each FAIL round. Sightings (coordinator, sent 15:24 CST Nov 8): #2266, #2296 and #2297 each posted one record at the end, naming rounds that read older heads; each record is void and needs a fresh chain. Correction (coordinator, sent 15:28 CST Nov 8): it withdrew its voids on #2224, #2296, #2235 and #2265; decision pr-review-record allows a record that lists rounds on older heads. The 15:24 CST sightings above (#2266, #2296, #2297 void) stand withdrawn too. Follow-up: step round-lines-carry-head.
